He revealed that he was diagnosed in 2011 and had been taking antiretroviral therapy (ART) to manage the virus. Sheen stated that he made his diagnosis public to raise awareness about HIV and to combat the stigma associated with the disease. He has since become an advocate for HIV research and treatment.
